name: railway
description: Connect Railway to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Railway MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Railway to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with projects, services and deployments using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Railway workspace.
Find anything in Railway that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review projects, services and deployments in Railway.
